# experiment-io

> Hardware abstraction for operant sessions: one loop (`drive`) that polls operanda and operates reinforcer devices for seeded virtual subjects, Arduino-style serial devices (newline-delimited JSON), and the contingency-rs hardware-in-the-loop bridge.

experiment-io is part of OperantKit, a set of Python/Rust packages for designing and running operant and respondent conditioning experiments (reinforcement schedules, session recording, analysis). Use it instead of hand-writing a device polling loop: responses on a concurrent schedule are routed to their operandum, the reinforcer is delivered by the device paired with that operandum, and the same session runs on virtual subjects with a manual clock for deterministic tests.

## Install

```bash
pip install git+https://github.com/OperantKit/experiment-io
pip install 'experiment-io[hw-serial] @ git+https://github.com/OperantKit/experiment-io'   # optional pyserial for real serial ports
```

## Minimal example

```python
from contingency import ScheduleBuilder
from experiment_core import ReinforcementCountExit
from experiment_io import drive
from experiment_io.hw.backends.virtual import ManualClock, RecordingReinforcer, VirtualOperandum, VirtualSubject
from session_runner import SessionConfig, SessionRunner

clock = ManualClock()
runner = SessionRunner(
    SessionConfig(name="demo", schedule=ScheduleBuilder.fr(3), exit_condition=ReinforcementCountExit(count=3)),
    clock=clock,
)
feeder = RecordingReinforcer(operandum_index=0)
runner.start(start_time=clock())
drive(runner, [VirtualOperandum(0, VirtualSubject(rate_hz=5.0, seed=0), clock)], [feeder], clock)
print(runner.state_name, runner.total_responses, len(feeder.calls))  # FINISHED 9 3
```

The example needs session-runner; experiment-io itself has no runtime dependency on other OperantKit packages.

## Docs

- [README](https://github.com/OperantKit/experiment-io/blob/main/README.md): backends, 30-second example, why not to hand-roll a hardware loop, wire formats
- [AGENTS.md](https://github.com/OperantKit/experiment-io/blob/main/AGENTS.md): when to use this package and what not to do

## Related packages

- [session-runner](https://github.com/OperantKit/session-runner): the session driver that `drive` feeds
- [experiment-core](https://github.com/OperantKit/experiment-core): session state machine and event types
- [contingency-py](https://github.com/OperantKit/contingency-py): reinforcement schedule engine
- [contingency-rs](https://github.com/OperantKit/contingency-rs): Rust port of the engine; its HIL binary is the other side of `HilBridge`
- [session-recorder](https://github.com/OperantKit/session-recorder): writes the session events to OKL v1 files
